# AxisWorks

> AxisWorks es un estudio de dos personas que diseña y programa webs a medida. Hacemos
> desarrollo web, identidad de marca y contenido. Trabajamos en español e inglés, desde
> España y Bali.

## Contacto
- Email: hello@axisworks.studio
- Web: https://axisworks.studio

## Key facts
- What we do: custom websites, web apps, brand identity and motion design
- Approach: hand-coded, non-template, design and development in the same hands
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Based: Spain ✕ Bali

## Services
- Web design and development (frontend and backend)
- Brand identity and design systems
- Motion design and premium interactions

## Pricing
- Web: from €100/month — maintenance and unlimited changes included
- Web ✕ Social: from €200/month — adds content calendar and profile work
